name: DiscoveryModule
description: ESPRack module: LAN device discovery over a custom UDP membership protocol (NOT mDNS, NOT a mesh network). Each device announces itself + learns peers (HMAC project-key trust tag + manifest-schema compatibility), exposes /api/v1/discovery/peers, and adds a Discovery page. Self-contained UDP socket; no mDNS responder. Compile-time excludable.
